# Expanda Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Accordion 05 featuring an interactive vertical accordion layout with distinct collapsible sections (Manage, Location, Hobbies) styled with modern Tailwind CSS 4 and Lucide icons.

## Section Structure & Order

1. **Header / Navbar**: App title ("Expanda"), subtitle, and theme/navigation toggle.
2. **Main Accordion Container**:
   - **Manage Section**: Expandable panel with sub-items (Account, Settings, Profile).
   - **Location Section**: Expandable panel with location metrics and details.
   - **Hobbies Section**: Expandable panel with hobby tags and descriptions.
3. **Footer**: Branded footer linking `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Design Notes

- Clean minimalist dashboard aesthetic with smooth transition animations for expand/collapse states.
- Color palette: Slate neutral background with Indigo/Purple accents.
- Icons: Lucide React (`User`, `MapPin`, `Heart`, `ChevronDown`, `Settings`).
